thread:
Sasha: quick sync — FinNova pushed a hard P0 on audit logs + BYO keystore before they sign. need to map acceptance criteria and a path to ship.
Arjun: noted. do we have an existing minimal flow we can promise?
Priya: we have three big risk gates: key escrow requirements, retention proof for 7+ years, and legal-hold overrides. any promise needs guardrails.
Ben: FinNova specifically called out: immutable audit chain, time-to-export SLA (24h), and BYOK handoff docs. they said legal will only greenlight after docs.
Sasha: ok — propose a "flight-check" list for launch. items: 1) BYOK handshake flow doc + sample API 2) audit export runbook (24h SLA) 3) retention config UI + default 7y 4) legal-hold immediate freeze path 5) ops runbook for key-rotation and recovery.
Arjun: on implementation: we can ship a V1 BYOK: upload public key + token handshake, store key meta, and provide export endpoint. no HSM integration yet. that'll cover most legal asks. ETA 3 sprints.
Priya: that V1 is acceptable to some customers, but FinNova asked for KMS attestations and proof of destruction. we'll need legal input on wording and a documented risk acceptance if we don't provide HSM-backed proofs.
Legal: true — we can draft contract language that limits liability if customer chooses V1 BYOK (software-keystore). but for escrow/HSM-level assurances we need separate addendum. also want to standardize acceptable evidence types: signed manifests, merkle summary, and timestamped export logs.
Ben: will push back with FinNova: ask them if V1 + addendum works for initial pilot, and ask which HSM vendors they need long term. i'll try to get a clear list this week.
Sasha: great. add two more items to flight-check: 6) evidence artifacts schema (signed-manifest + checksum) 7) UI and API release notes + customer-facing runbook.
Arjun: ops question — for retention enforcement, do we enforce tenant-level TTLs today? We have retention flags but not immutable retention buckets. locking a 7y immutable bucket requires storage policy changes.
OpsBot: deployment-note: immutable-buckets feature flagged in prod-ops branch. requires DB migration 'retention_buckets_v2' and S3 lifecycle config changes. ETA depends on migrations window.
Priya: if we can't do immutable buckets before customer go-live, we must document the gap and provide compensating controls (audit alerts + faster exports). do not promise immutability.
Sasha: decision checklist for product: A) Commitment we can make publicly (what goes into contract language) B) Compensating controls to offer while full feature ships C) Launch gating — go/no-go owners. propose: Product (Sasha) signoff, Security (Priya) risk acceptance, Legal (Legal) contract approval, Eng (Arjun) capacity OK, Sales (Ben) customer consent.
Ben: fine from sales. will ask FinNova to sign an MOA for pilot with the listed gaps and proposed compensations.
Arjun: quick technical note for docs — include the handshake example: ```POST /v1/byok/handshake {"tenant_id": "fin123", "public_key": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----..."}``` and the export manifest format: ```{ "export_id": "e-123", "timestamp": 1738000000, "signed_manifest": "base64sig", "blob_checksum": "sha256:..." }```
Priya: add acceptance tests: 1) export manifest verification 2) retention config cannot be shortened by non-admin 3) legal-hold immediately flags export endpoints. testing owner: Eng QA.
Sasha: timeline: if we prioritize this as sprint+1 we can have V1 BYOK + export runbook + contract language in 3 sprints. immutable bucket work is longer (4-6 sprints). can we scope MVP to support the sale?
Legal: we'll draft the addendum template by next Tue. will include sample evidence types and an explicit list of what we *don't* guarantee for V1.
Ben: i'll confirm FinNova acceptance by Fri. if they require HSM before PO, we escalate.
Sasha: action items: Arjun -> spec PR with handshake API + manifest schema (due EOD Tue). Priya -> risk memo + compensating controls (due Wed). Legal -> addendum draft (Tue). Ben -> customer confirmation (Fri). I'll own flight-check doc and final gating table.
Arjun: noted, starting spec PR.
Priya: noted.
Ben: on it.
Sasha: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll reconvene after Ben has customer confirmation.
